chunks: From him, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, he raised it to Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'I shall teach you a supplication by which you will not forget the Quran.'

O Allah! Have mercy on me by causing me to neglect Your disobedience forever as long as You keep me alive, and have mercy on me from burdening myself with what does not concern me, and grant me a good perspective in what pleases You regarding me, and make my heart steadfast in memorizing Your Book as You taught me, and grant me to recite it in the manner that pleases You regarding me.

O Allah! Illuminate my sight with Your Book, expand my chest with it, gladden my heart with it, loosen my tongue with it, and employ my body with it, and strengthen me upon that and assist me on it, for there is no assistant upon it except You. There is no god except You.
He said: And some of our companions have reported from Walid ibn Sabih, from Hafs al-Awar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for memorizing and reciting the Quran correctly?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this supplication emphasizes the holistic integration of Quranic memorization with spiritual purity, linking the preservation of the text to the avoidance of sin and the purification of the heart. It reflects the Shia emphasis on the Quran as a living guide that illuminates the senses and strengthens the body for worship, ensuring recitation is not merely mechanical but deeply pleasing to God.

en.hubeali:
From him, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘I<sup>saww</sup> shall teach you a supplication, (by which) you will not forget the Quran,

‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Have Mercy on me so I neglect disobeying You<sup>azwj</sup> for ever what it my remaining (life), and have Mercy on me from encumbering what is not befitting for me, and Grace me the good scenery in what would Please You<sup>azwj</sup> from me, and Impose the memorisation of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Book in my heart just as You<sup>azwj</sup> Taught me and Graced me that I recite it upon as which would Please You<sup>azwj</sup> from me.

O Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>! Illuminate my vision by Your<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Book and Expand my chest by it, and Cause my heart to be happy with it, and Loosen my tongue by it, and Utilise my body by it, and Strengthen me upon that, and Assist me upon it, (for) there is no Aider upon it except You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>. There is no god except You<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>’’.
He (the narrator) said, ‘Some of our companions have reported from Waleed Bin Sabeeh, from Hafs Al-Awr, from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa in a marfu ’ manner from Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) who has said the following:
“The Messenger of Allah has said, T like to instruct you with a supplication to help you not to forget the Holy Quran

when you say, “O Lord, favor me to avoid, for ever, disobeying You, as long as You will keep me alive, favor me from being burdened with that which does not concern me, grant me beautiful appearance in that which pleases You from me, hold my heart on memorizing Your book as You have taught me. Confer upon me the opportunity to read the way it will please You with me.

O Lord, give light with Your book to my eyes, open thereby my chest, enlightened with it my heart, free up with it my tongue, make my body work for it and strengthen me thereby, there is no helper in this task except You, no one deserves to be worshipped except Allah.’”
Certain individuals of our people have narrated it from Walid ibn Sabih from Hafs al-‘A’war from abu ‘Abd Allah , recipient of divine supreme covenant.”
